mapper.sql: vehicle_id, status, position_x, position_y, position_frame, heading, speed, has_cargo, cargo_id, message_at, received_at
mapper.select: SELECT v.vehicle_id FROM vehicle v JOIN vehicle_current_status s ON s.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id WHERE v.active = TRUE AND s.status = 'IDLE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM transport_task t WHERE t.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id AND t.status IN ( 'ASSIGNED', 'MOVING_TO_PICKUP', 'MEASURING', 'PICKING_UP', 'TRANSPORTING', 'PLACING' ) ) ORDER BY v.vehicle_id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle_current_status (vehicle_id, status, received_at) VALUES (#{vehicleId}, #{status}, #{receivedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), received_at = VALUES(received_at)

INSERT INTO vehicle_current_status (vehicle_id, status, position_x, position_y, position_frame, heading, speed, message_at, received_at) VALUES (#{vehicleId}, 'UNKNOWN', #{positionX}, #{positionY}, #{positionFrame}, #{heading}, #{speed}, #{messageAt}, #{receivedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE position_x = CASE WHEN message_at IS NULL OR message_at < VALUES(message_at) THEN VALUES(position_x) ELSE position_x END, position_y = CASE WHEN message_at IS NULL OR message_at < VALUES(message_at) THEN VALUES(position_y) ELSE position_y END, position_frame = CASE WHEN message_at IS NULL OR message_at < VALUES(message_at) THEN VALUES(position_frame) ELSE position_frame END, heading = CASE WHEN message_at IS NULL OR message_at < VALUES(message_at) THEN VALUES(heading) ELSE heading END, speed = CASE WHEN message_at IS NULL OR message_at < VALUES(message_at) THEN VALUES(speed) ELSE speed END, received_at = CASE WHEN message_at IS NULL OR message_at < VALUES(message_at) THEN VALUES(received_at) ELSE received_at END, message_at = CASE WHEN message_at IS NULL OR message_at < VALUES(message_at) THEN VALUES(message_at) ELSE message_at END
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(s.status, 'UNKNOWN') AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM vehicle v LEFT JOIN vehicle_current_status s ON v.vehicle_id = s.vehicle_id WHERE v.active = true GROUP BY COALESCE(s.status, 'UNKNOWN')
